Run by tests/test_freshness_vocab.py against core/freshness_vocab.py AND (through node) against src/freshness.ts, and by test/freshness.test.ts. 'planted' classes: the REAL patterns, tolerance and cadence table from the code, with these sets instead of the registry's. expect_units lists the /v1/last-updates status of each unit; expect_next is whether next_update_expected is still promised.
